text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if her lack of spotlight at the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen was all a lie, the 
crowd eagerly anticipates Aston Machan's 
run! And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The official URA mascot is finally 
complete! Giving it to her Trainer first 
of all, Aston Machan heads into the race 
with a smile!
